BiblicalUsage: Gershon is a person named 17 times in Scripture, in Genesis, Exodus, and Numbers. The full story lives on the Gershon profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gershon matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
